title: Unit 13 Review: the Colombian Andes
goal: Review the páramos, Bogotá, Medellín, the coffee landscape and García Márquez, with relative clauses and the subjunctive, *el hecho de que*, *no es que… sino que…*, the passive *se* and stance adverbs.
grammar: review: relative clauses with the subjunctive, el hecho de que, no es que sino que, passive se, stance adverbs

items: I can review what I learned about the Colombian Andes, from the páramos to Gabo.
I can use relative clauses with the subjunctive, *el hecho de que*, *no es que… sino que…*, the passive *se* and stance adverbs.
I can put events from 1538 to 2018 in order.
I can attribute a judgement about Medellín instead of stating it as my own.
I can say what I am looking for or what does not exist with *que* + subjunctive.
I can comment on a fact everyone knows with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive.
I can reject a reason and give the real one with *no es que* + subjunctive and *sino que* + indicative (review).
I can describe how something is done with the passive *se* (*se recoge*, *se secan*) (review).
I can comment on a fact with a stance adverb such as *en realidad*, *en rigor* or *afortunadamente* (review).
